summary: INVO Fertility filed an 8-K disclosing an investor presentation and provided an update on an Any Market Purchase Agreement with Alumni Capital LP. The company has sold 2,094,395 shares for approximately $3.59 million at an average price of $1.71 per share under the agreement, which allows up to $15 million (expandable to $50 million) in sales. This is a structured equity distribution program, representing ongoing dilution but also a capital-raising mechanism. What to watch: pace of additional sales and market reaction to continued share issuance.
